rankingRule.primary: More completed examples is better; use the minimum completion count across three complete runs.
rankingRule.secondary: For equal completion counts, lower median total render/export time is better.
rankingRule.ties: Identical completion counts and median times share a rank.
rankingRule.scope: Rank SVG and PNG separately through the declared public execution paths. Native CLI time includes per-example process startup.
rankingRule.incomplete: Fewer than three complete runs, or mixed versions/boundaries, remain unranked.
